materials.name: Concrete shell
materials.detail: Create a continuous buried enclosure with explicit joints, support and drainage.
materials.status: Material family proposed; structure and mix not designed.

materials.name: Warm pale stone
materials.use: Deep entrance cuts and retaining-wall faces
materials.detail: Give the approved entrances real texture, joints and substantial corners.
materials.status: Appearance proposal; stone, finish, anchors and sample unselected.

materials.name: Bronze-toned frames
materials.use: Entry doors, glazing and limited trim
materials.detail: Keep a quiet, warm edge against the stone.
materials.status: Finish proposal; alloy, glazing and thermal/security details unselected.

materials.name: Sheltered warm soffits
materials.detail: Add warmth at human height without changing the hill silhouette.
materials.status: Timber-toned proposal; fire, moisture and maintenance review required.

materials.name: Textured paving
materials.use: Arrival walks, landings and rear service interfaces
materials.detail: Keep the route dry, readable and continuous with deliberate joints.
materials.status: Finish/base proposal; wet slip, accessibility and drainage unresolved.

materials.name: Low roof meadow and ground planting
materials.use: Low vegetation above the roof; larger shrubs/trees in verified true ground
materials.detail: Keep the approved lush landform while separating roof substrate from deep soil and tree roots.
materials.status: Species, growing medium, installation/mature sizes and maintenance unselected.

quantities.name: Gross floor plates
quantities.limit: Two model footprints; usable area still requires an agreed definition.

quantities.name: Floor to roof underside
quantities.limit: Modeled clear shell height before equipment or services; structure is schematic.

quantities.name: Ground trees
quantities.limit: 12 added in this revision. Species, nursery sizes and root space are not yet specified.

quantities.name: Pedestrian entrance openings
quantities.limit: Two front and two rear openings; not a fire/egress design.

steps: Keep the approved appearance as the target and show the same model from arrival, rear, aerial and section views.
Tie the model to the correct expansion parcel and collect the existing site/utility reports before commissioning missing investigations.
Design one complete representative section with structure, waterproofing, insulation, drainage, planting and service access.
Approve stone, metal, paving and soffit samples; show day-one planting separately from the intended grown-in landscape.
Issue a coordinated material/element schedule and quantity take-off with assumptions, exclusions and an exact model version. Have the design team and contractor check it before procurement.
